pages.text: Hooked makes grappling hooks feel simple, natural, and genuinely useful — not a gimmick.$(br2)Craft an Iron Hook as soon as you have iron. Right-click to fire, and you'll swing toward whatever it latches onto. Hit a wall mid-fall and you'll hang from it. Hit the ceiling and you'll dangle. It integrates cleanly with ParCool movement.

$(bold)Tiers:$()$(br)$(bold)Iron Hook$() — baseline range and pull speed$(br)$(bold)Diamond Hook$() — faster pull$(br)$(bold)Ender Hook$() — longest range, fastest$(br2)$(bold)Two hooks:$() Fire into two different surfaces and you'll hover at their midpoint. Good for holding position during ranged or spell combat, or for crossing large gaps.
Iron ingots + sticks. Upgrade to Diamond and Ender tiers with the same recipe using better materials.
